import pytest

from todo import add_todo, complete_todo
def test_add_todo_raises_typeerror_for_none():
    todo_list = []
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="Todo item cannot be None"):
        add_todo(todo_list, None)

def test_add_todo_appends_item():
    todo_list = []
    add_todo(todo_list, "Buy groceries")
    assert todo_list == ["Buy groceries"]

def test_complete_todo_raises_typeerror_for_none():
    todo_list = []
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="Todo item cannot be None"):
        complete_todo(todo_list, None)

def test_complete_todo_marks_item_as_done():
    todo_list = ["Buy groceries"]
    result = complete_todo(todo_list, "Buy groceries")
    assert result == ["Done: Buy groceries"]

def test_complete_todo_returns_original_list_if_item_not_found():
    todo_list = ["Buy groceries"]
    result = complete_todo(todo_list, "Pay bills")
    assert result == ["Buy groceries"]

def test_complete_todo_modifies_list_in_place():
    todo_list = ["Buy groceries"]
    complete_todo(todo_list, "Buy groceries")
    assert todo_list == ["Done: Buy groceries"]

def test_complete_todo_handles_duplicate_items():
    todo_list = ["Buy groceries", "Buy groceries"]
    result = complete_todo(todo_list, "Buy groceries")
    assert result == ["Done: Buy groceries", "Buy groceries"]
